name: Superconduction / dismemberment

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A very brittle glassy ice and bone snap with a piercing tiny electrical chirp and a shower of fine crystalline ticks. Frozen electrically charged limb detachment.
